title: Unique native tensor-forgetting comparison with the full representative square
statement: Let k0 be a finite field, l a prime different from its characteristic, and X a scheme over k0. Fix the native tensor T with its tensor-Hom adjunction, an underived tensor-forgetting isomorphism e and chain isomorphisms with its prescribed summands. Fix a native ringed bridge b, native complex tensor models A (including the K-flat localization), ringed tensor data SB, TB, betaB, cB, ordinary Hom data M and a closed structure S. Suppose ordinaryModel computes S.tensor by the ordinary total tensor whenever its first curried input is ordinary K-flat, and is natural in both complexes. Then there exists a unique natural isomorphism t from nativeWeilRingedMonoidal(b,SB).tensor followed by nativeForget to nativeForget in both variables followed by S.tensor such that, for every native K-flat P and arbitrary complex Q, forgetting nativeWeilRingedTensorModel(P,Q), followed by the exact-functor factor on total(P,Q) and the localized chain comparison, equals t at (Q(Q),Q(P)), followed by S.tensor applied to the two exact-functor factors and ordinaryModel(U(P),U(Q)). All factor maps have the orientations displayed in the Lean statement. No coherence assertion is included. The models and functors are those of def-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-model, def-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-structure and def-sf-native-weil-closed-models.

source.place: Representative-square part of native tensor transport; Stacks 06YU; product localization and Mathlib Localization.Prod/Predicate

proof.text: Curry the underived comparison. The summand equation identifies the supplied chain map with mapBifunctorComparison, whose existing naturality theorem gives naturality of the chain isomorphism.

On pairs (Q,P) with P native K-flat, compose the native tensor model, the exact forgetting factorization, the chain comparison, the inverse ordinary model and the inverse exact factors on the two inputs. Native and ordinary model naturality give a natural isomorphism.

The product of DerivedCategory.Q and the supplied K-flat localization A.localization is a localization. Apply Localization.fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft and preimageIso to descend the isomorphism. Its preimage equation followed by cancellation gives the full representative square. Faithfulness and cancellation prove uniqueness of every comparison satisfying this square.

proof_origin.place: Direct product-localization proof of the representative square and its uniqueness; proved, with no split-off hole.

mathlib_searches.query: The natural transformations between two functors on a localization correspond bijectively to natural transformations after restriction along the localization functor
mathlib_searches.results: Localization.natTrans_ext and Localization.liftNatTrans; restriction is fully faithful.

mathlib_searches.verdict: Use this fully faithful restriction and its preimageIso.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Localization/Prod.lean and Predicate.lean: product localization instance and fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft.
mathlib_searches.verdict: These existing APIs close the descent and uniqueness steps.
